description: After a send, rewrite one manifest: status (default "sent") and postUrl. Every other field is preserved exactly — the file is read, patched and re-serialized.

day.description: Narrow an id to one YYYY-MM-DD folder.

path.description: The manifest file, instead of an id.

status.description: Defaults to sent for a post and live for an ad creative. Must fit the manifest: a post takes queued, sent, held or failed; a creative takes draft, review, approved, live or archived.

name: mark_sent
